content.text: This chapter describes implemented integrations through their items, setup and limits. Install each relevant mod with its own dependencies. The core remains usable without optional mods; absent external item icons may be omitted.
Requires Create. This is Create's Hand Crank, obtained through Create recipes, not the Ancient Warfare Hand-Cranked Generator.

Equip a player-owned worker with a hammer to make a craftsman. Record the Hand Crank in a Work Order with the default Z key, check the entry, then give the order to the worker. Provide food and an accessible work position. The worker refreshes the crank's normal forward turn while working.

The connected network uses Create's native rotation and load rules. Only the Hand Crank is integrated; this does not operate every Create machine or convert Ancient Warfare torque into Create speed or stress.
